messages:
Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — PhotonPay wants to change the renewal terms. They want to add 12 seats but shorten the term to 9 months and pay via PO. Asking for vendor-code + esign path today. Can @Josh (AE) confirm pricing cadence?

Josh (AE): Got it. Do we keep the same ARR rate and prorate for 9mo, or do they want a term-based discount? They asked for a small concession if we shorten.

Maria (CS): They asked for a 7% concession on list for the 9mo since they’re moving from annual -> shorter. They’ll commit to seat add immediately at renewal date. CFO contact is lena.cfo@photonpay.com; will be signer.

Eli (Legal): Shortening term + pricing concession ok in principle. We need an SOW amendment + signature from their authorized signer. Also confirm billing entity — do they want to bill "PhotonPay EU" or existing US entity? Entity swap affects invoices + PO.

Anika (Finance): If it's PhotonPay EU we need their VAT/tax id and official PO header. Without that, vendor code + invoice routing will take longer. Ask them for PO format now.

Maria (CS): They just replied: PO will come from EU entity but can include US tax details if needed. Sending their PO stub next.

Maria (CS): ```
PO stub:
- PO#: (TBD by customer)
- BillTo: PhotonPay EU
- NetTerms: Net30
- Contact: lena.cfo@photonpay.com
```

Josh (AE): Thanks — two asks: 1) can we hold price and prorate seat start date? 2) If legal drafts addendum today I can push for signer EOD. If they need vendor code now, Anika please advise ETA.

Anika (Finance): Vendor code creation is 24–48h after PO and tax id. If they can provide PO number + VAT ID now, we can usually turn it around tomorrow.

Eli (Legal): I'll draft a short amendment template: 9mo term, 12-seat add, pro-rated invoice schedule, 7% concession on listed seats. Will include signatory block for CFO. Aim to share by COB tomorrow.

Maria (CS): Great. I'll ask PhotonPay for PO number + VAT now and confirm signer availability for tomorrow afternoon. Also planning a short enablement session for the new seats — do we offer 30-min free onboarding?

Josh (AE): Offer 30-min preflight, yes. If they sign EOD we can schedule next Tue.

DocuSignBot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0b3c) — awaiting documents. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0b3c

Maria (CS): Action items: Josh -> confirm concession and signer time by EOD; Anika -> vendor code once PO+VAT received; Eli -> amendment draft by COB tomorrow; Maria -> collect PO + schedule enablement.

Josh (AE): Sounds good. :thumbsup:
